title: Explore: Main UI host wiring
description: Inspect the shipped desktop analysis surface and verify whether the writing-craft dashboard is mounted from a production-visible host.
findings: AnalysisPanel only exposes character_arc, pacing, consistency, and readability tabs; it never imports or renders WritingDashboard, so the main UI cannot reach the writing-craft control path.
recommendations: Mount WritingDashboard from a visible AnalysisPanel tab or another shipped host and prove the user path with an integration test.

title: Explore: Desktop API bridge coverage
description: Inspect the desktop bridge layer for writing-craft requests and verify whether direct bridge contract coverage exists.
findings: desktop/src/api/writing-craft.ts defines real callApi wrappers for /writing-craft/analyze and /writing-craft/llm-analyze, but desktop/src/api/writing-craft.test.ts is missing, so request payloads and endpoint contracts are not directly locked.
recommendations: Add a focused bridge-layer test that mocks callApi and verifies both request shapes plus passthrough behavior.

title: Explore: Deep-analysis wiring
description: Inspect the dashboard-to-detail chain for the LLM deep-analysis control path.
findings: WritingDimensionDetail supports analyzeWritingCraftLLM when text and llmConfig are present, but WritingDashboard renders <WritingDimensionDetail dimension={activeDimension} /> without forwarding either prop, making the deep-analysis control unreachable.
recommendations: Thread text and llmConfig into WritingDimensionDetail, or remove the dormant control until configuration is available.

title: Explore: Planned warning artifact
description: Inspect whether the planned anti-pattern warning surface exists and is wired into the writing-craft detail view.
findings: desktop/src/components/intelligence/AntiPatternWarning.tsx is absent, so the planned warning visualization never shipped and cannot surface anti-pattern signals in the detail flow.
recommendations: Implement AntiPatternWarning and wire it into WritingDimensionDetail or explicitly descoped the feature in the fix plan.

title: Synthesis: Root-cause and fix clusters
description: Synthesize the UI-backend control gaps into a fix-ready context for the quality-fix chain.
findings: The blocking gap is not backend availability but host-path absence: the backend and isolated dashboard work, yet the production host never mounts the dashboard and the nested deep-analysis path is partially unwired. Secondary gaps are missing bridge coverage and a missing warning component.
recommendations: Fix in three clusters: visible host integration, bridge/test coverage, and deep-analysis/warning completion. Treat host integration first because it unblocks the only real user control path.
